privacidade:
1. What this policy covers

This document applies to the website www.outboxgroup.com.br and to the data that reaches us through it. If you hire us for a project, the relationship is also governed by the contract signed between the parties.

2. What data we collect

We only collect what you type into the contact form:

  • Name and email, so we can reply to you;
  • Type of service you are interested in, so we understand your request;
  • Message, if you choose to write one (optional field);
  • Video call preference, when you check that option.

We also temporarily record the IP address of whoever submits the form, only to limit automated submissions and prevent spam. This record stays in the server's memory and is not stored in a database.

We do not ask for your CPF (Brazilian taxpayer ID), bank details, card details or any sensitive data. If you choose to write this kind of information in the message field on your own, please avoid it.

3. What we use it for

  • Replying to your inquiry and talking about the project;
  • Preparing a quote and proposal, when applicable;
  • Scheduling a video call, if you asked for one.

We do not use your data for advertising, we do not build behavioral profiles and we do not sell or rent your data to anyone.

4. Legal basis

We process the form data on the legal basis of preliminary procedures related to a contract, set out in Article 7, item V, of Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Law 13.709/2018). In other words: you reached out to us about a possible service, and we need your data to reply.

5. Where the data is stored

Messages sent through the form are stored in a database hosted on Supabase and also forwarded by email to felipe@outboxgroup.com.br. The website is hosted on a server of our own, managed by OutBox Group.

These providers may process data outside Brazil. The transfer is protected by an encrypted connection and limited to what is necessary for the service to work.

6. Who has access

Only the OutBox Group team, through a dashboard protected by login and password. We do not share your data with third parties, except when required by law or court order.

7. How long we keep it

  • Inquiries that did not become a project: up to 24 months, in case you want to pick the conversation back up;
  • Inquiries that became a project: for the term of the contract and for the period required by tax law;
  • At any time: if you ask us to delete your data, we delete it before these periods end, except for what the law requires us to keep.

8. Security

The website runs on HTTPS with a valid certificate. Access to the admin dashboard requires authentication, and the database uses security rules that prevent public reading of the inquiries. No system is infallible, but we work to keep risks to a minimum.

9. Your rights

You can request confirmation, access, correction, anonymization, portability or deletion of your data, and you can also withdraw consent. We explain how to exercise each of these rights on the LGPD and your rights page.

10. Cookies

Our use of cookies and local storage is described in detail in the Cookie Policy.

11. Changes to this policy

If we change anything relevant, we update the date at the top of this page. The version published here is always the one in effect.

12. Contact us

Questions, requests or complaints about personal data: felipe@outboxgroup.com.br. We reply within 15 days.

cookies:
1. What cookies are

Cookies are small files that a website stores in your browser to remember something. There is also local storage, which works in a similar way. We cover both here.

2. What we use today

To put it plainly: this website does not use advertising or tracking cookies. We have no social media pixel, no audience analytics tool, and we do not build browsing profiles.

The full list of what is stored in your browser:

Essential (always active)

  • Admin dashboard session: a cookie created by Supabase only when someone from OutBox logs in at /admin. If you are a visitor, this cookie is never created in your browser.
  • Your cookie choice: we store in your browser's local storage whether you accepted or declined, precisely so we do not ask again on every visit. It stays only on your device.

Preferences

  • Dashboard theme: remembers whether the administrator chose light or dark mode. It also stays only on the device of whoever uses the dashboard.

Analytics and marketing

None at the moment. If we ever start using any, this page will be updated first, and the tool will only load if you accept.

3. External services

The website's fonts are loaded from Google Fonts and Fontshare, the blog images come from Supabase and the map on the homepage comes from OpenStreetMap. These services receive your IP address because they are network requests, which happens on any website that uses external resources. They do not set tracking cookies through our website.

4. How to change your choice

You can review your decision whenever you want, at no cost and with no red tape. Just use the button below.

You can also delete cookies and site data directly in your browser settings. Blocking the essential items does not affect public browsing, only access to the admin dashboard.

5. Related documents

See also the Privacy Policy and the LGPD and your rights page.

6. Questions

Reach us at felipe@outboxgroup.com.br.
lgpd:
1. Our commitment

OutBox Group processes personal data in accordance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Law 13.709/2018). We collect the minimum necessary, use it only for the purpose we stated and do not sell data to anyone.

2. What data we process

From the website, only what you fill in on the contact form: name, email, service of interest, an optional message and whether you checked interest in a video call. The full details are in the Privacy Policy.

3. Your rights

You can exercise the following rights at any time and at no cost:

  • Confirmation and access: Find out whether we process any of your data and receive a copy.
  • Correction: Correct data that is incomplete, outdated or wrong.
  • Anonymization or blocking: Ask that unnecessary data, or data processed unlawfully, be anonymized or blocked.
  • Deletion: Ask us to delete your data, subject to the retention periods the law requires us to observe.
  • Portability: Receive your data in a format that can be transferred to another provider.
  • Information about sharing: Find out who we share your data with. In our case, only the providers named in the Privacy Policy.
  • Withdrawal of consent: Withdraw a permission you gave earlier, when the processing is based on consent.
  • Review of automated decisions: Ask for a human review of a decision made solely by a machine. We do not currently make any decision of this kind.

4. How to exercise them

Send an email to felipe@outboxgroup.com.br with the subject “LGPD”, saying which right you want to exercise. To protect you, we may ask for some information to confirm your identity before fulfilling the request.

Response time: up to 15 days, as provided by law. If the request is complex, we will let you know and explain why.

5. Data Protection Officer

Our Data Protection Officer (DPO) is Felipe Melo, and the contact channel is felipe@outboxgroup.com.br.

6. Security incidents

If an incident occurs that may pose a significant risk to you, we will notify the affected data subjects and Brazil's National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) within the deadlines set by law.

7. If you are not satisfied

Talk to us first: we almost always resolve things quickly. If you still believe your rights were not respected, you can file a complaint with Brazil's National Data Protection Authority (ANPD).
